# DS3_TARGET_REPLAY - fast replay of alternative exits on the JL2 trade list (W-RP, FIRST PASS)
> VALIDATION (W-DV, FIRST PASS, 2026-11-16): trials counted 181 rules x 15 book-session scopes = 2,715 screens (TRIALS_LEDGER.csv); correction none on this page (replay screen; best-of-N winners here are NOT corrected: read them with the DSR in DV_FAMILY_SNOOP.csv, which fails at this N); PBO not fitted; number shown is IN-SAMPLE (43 months); data end 2026-10-31.

VERDICT (data ends 2026-10-31; FIRST PASS, replay only, no engine, no controls; families built so far: a,b,c,d,e,f,g,h,i,j,k): see ranking tables below.

Method: JL2 trades (18979, 43 months), 1-s tape paths (code/th_pm / th_bd loader), real entry and real exit kept; alternative exit = earlier of alternative and real exit. Fixed target fill = limit at the level, touch = fill, 0 slippage; variant a_T*_thru requires the 1-s trade-high to pass the level by one tick. Partials (b): limit at level (variant _s80 = level minus 0.80 slip); remainder to the real exit; BE=1 stop to entry after the partial (lock 0). Steps (c): book target (cell median of Target exits) then 40 after N min then 25 after 2N min; if mid is already beyond the new level at the step second, exit at mid. Trail (g): armed once favourable excursion >= A, stop = previous-second favourable extreme minus D, fill at the stop level. Day direction (d): D10 3-of-4 vote from closed 1-min bars (d10_core.day_dir). e: k x max(0, HAR forecast range - session range so far), floor 20, cap book target (bd_room.feats). f: own atr_rel (5-min ATR14 over the median of previous <=20 days of daily medians; static tercile cuts 0.94/1.62) and 5-min squeeze on/off (cf4_squeeze, coverage 100%).

REPLAY IGNORES FREED-BOOK RE-ENTRIES (path effect) and any change in later signals; exact engine decides. Dollars are BASE lots, engine fee $1.18/contract RT; column "@4.84" reprices at $4.84 RT; "x1.75" = live lots max(1,floor(1.75 x base+0.5)) at $4.84 with partials exiting floor(live x 0.5) min 1 (live-lot rounding effect of partials in column liveeff = x1.75 delta minus 1.75 x base delta, $/wk). DD, worst week and HOLD-path (2025-11-17..12-10) are WHOLE-STACK with only the scope changed; mean is the scope own mean. Rank = sum of four % DD improvements (whole-stack 43 months, whole-stack HOLD path, own-stream 43 months, own-stream HOLD path; the stack max DD of 43 months IS the HOLD path episode 2025-11-17..12-10, so own-stream DD is added to separate small cells); gate = scope mean (43 mo) not more than 5% below base. surf = neighbours (same family lattice) that also improve the score; ISO = isolated (fewer than half agree).

Baseline whole stack (real JL2): FULL43 DD -74402 worst week -43527 mean/wk 8796; HOLD DD -74402 worst week -31211 mean/wk 8359; HP DD -74402 worst week -31211 mean/wk -17018; L6M DD -22565 worst week -13430 mean/wk 22076; L3M DD -22565 worst week -13430 mean/wk 17566. At $4.84: 43mo DD -76173 HP DD -76173. x1.75: 43mo DD -144400 HP DD -140077.
